'''Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪''' (Japanese: '''チャモチャモ☆ぷりてぃ''') is a {{pkmn|manga}} series by the ''{{wp|shōjo}}'' author [[Yumi Tsukirino]], and is a sequel to [[Magical Pokémon Journey]].

The series is a comedy-styled manga which follows the adventures of {{TP|Haruka|Torchic}} as she attempts to win over her crush, {{TP|Kanata|Mightyena}}, whom she meets after moving with [[Haruka (CCP)|her Trainer]] from the city to a small town. {{TP|Hazel|Pikachu}} and {{TP|Hazel|Clefairy}} reappear as supporting characters, as well as new friends {{TP|Kanata|Poochyena}}, {{CCP|Delcatty}}, and [[Chiru-Chiru]]. Chapters commonly focus on coming-of-age themes such as friendship and having crushes, yet retain the zany sense of humor seen in the manga's predecessor. 

This manga features [[Generation III]] Pokémon, and used to run in [[Ciao]].

==Trivia==
* Similar to [[Magical Pokémon Journey]], it is common in this manga for Pokémon to speak the human language.
* Volumes frequently contain personality quizzes that assign the reader to a character from the series.
* Magical Pokémon Journey's "Pokémon File" continues in this manga, as well as the frequent appearances of [[Yumi Tsukirino]]'s author avatar to discuss her experiences of writing the series and playing {{game|Ruby and Sapphire|s}}.
